papers.title_en: FigmaEval: A Benchmark for Evaluating AI Agents in Professional UI Design
papers.authors: Xinyue Huang, Yongyong Gao, Zhengyuan Pan, Zheng Wei, Xinya Liu, Duanyi Yan, Zhiyu Hang, Zheng Ma, Lewei Lu
papers.tldr: AI智能体已能借助Figma等专业工具自主设计UI，但开放式设计任务缺乏唯一真值，评估其专业设计能力仍很困难。为此，作者构建FigmaEval基准，包含84个任务和783个界面，来自真实Figma文件，采用约束规格、开放方案范式，并设计22条专家评分规则与人类盲评比对。评估11个模型后发现，规则评分与设计师偏好高度一致，不同模型在设计实践和质量效率权衡上差异明显。该基准为系统评估专业UI设计能力提供了可复现框架。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in AI agents have enabled autonomous UI design using professional tools such as Figma, yet evaluating their design capabilities remains challenging due to the open-ended nature of design tasks and the absence of unique ground truths. We introduce FigmaEval, a benchmark for evaluating AI agents on professional UI design tasks, comprising 84 tasks and 783 screens derived from real-world Figma design files. FigmaEval adopts a constrained-specification, open-solution paradigm, standardizing task requirements and design resources while allowing agents to independently determine layouts, visual hierarchies, component composition, and visual presentation. To assess design quality beyond reference similarity, we develop 22 expert-grounded evaluation rubrics across six dimensions and introduce a human evaluation arena where professional designers compare agent-generated designs through blinded pairwise judgments. Evaluating eleven models under a unified Figma agent setup, we find substantial agreement between rubric-based assessments and human preferences, alongside distinct differences in design practices and quality--efficiency trade-offs. FigmaEval provides a framework for systematically assessing professional UI design capabilities and understanding the strengths and limitations of current AI agents.

papers.title_en: How Much Do Coding Agents Over-Edit, and Why? An Empirical Study of Unneeded Edits in Repository-Level Agent Patches
papers.authors: Aakash Goel, Benjamin Steenhoek, Yu Hu
papers.evidence: 回放智能体轨迹并将补丁块归因到具体步骤
papers.tldr: 智能体补丁常大于开发者补丁，但大小无法判断额外编辑是否必要。作者提出DRA，回放轨迹并把最终补丁每个代码块归因到写入步骤，逐块回滚重跑测试以判定必要性。在SWE-bench Verified与DeepSWE的7,660条已解决轨迹上，智能体代码平均不比开发者更不必要，但约11%代码单元仍多余且多数改变行为；仅用可见测试剪枝可移除多数多余代码，89%补丁仍解题。研究建议基准同时报告代码必要性与解决率，并以训练和框架级剪枝治理过度编辑。
papers.abstract_en: Agent patches are larger than developers', which is widely read as over-editing. But patch size does not say whether the extra edits are needed, what they are, or where they come from. We introduce Delta Residue Attribution (DRA), which replays agent trajectories, traces every block (unit) of the final patch to the step that wrote it, reverts each unit, and reruns the task tests to decide whether the unit is needed. We apply DRA to 7,660 resolved GitHub Copilot CLI trajectories from 18 frontier models on SWE-bench Verified (6,728) and DeepSWE (932), and grade developer patches using the same method. Agent patches do change more lines than developers'; on SWE-bench Verified the majority of extra edits add tests (61%) and documentation (13%) while on DeepSWE, most extra edits are code (58%). On both benchmarks, agents' code is on average at least as necessary as developers' (mean $NP_{code}$ 0.887 vs. 0.864 on SWE-bench Verified, where 11 of 18 models leave less unneeded code than developers, and 0.797 vs. 0.785 on DeepSWE). On average, 11% of an agent patch's code units on SWE-bench Verified are still unneeded, and 89% of those change behavior. Debug steps write almost none of the unneeded code. Code necessity differs substantially by model; it is unrelated to resolve rate on SWE-bench Verified and negatively correlated with it on DeepSWE (Spearman -0.59, p = 0.01). On SWE-bench Verified, pruning with DRA using only the tests the agent can see (its own tests and the repository's) removes the majority of unneeded code but also some needed code (67% recall, 46% precision), and 89% of pruned patches still resolve the task; asking the agent to audit its own diff is more precise but less effective (36% recall, 66% precision). We recommend that benchmarks report code necessity next to resolve rate and that over-editing be addressed through model training and harness-level pruning.

papers.title_en: Automatic Occupational Coding through Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Mathijs A. Langezaal, Egon L. van den Broek, Lukas P. A. Arts, Marcel Goldberg, Grégoire Rey, Melissa C. Friesen, Sarah J. Locke, Nathaniel Rothman, Qing Lan, Roel C. H. Vermeulen, Susan Peters
papers.evidence: 将检索增强生成用于知识密集型职业编码
papers.tldr: 职业暴露每年造成190万死亡和8970万伤残调整寿命年，但队列岗位文本靠人工编码，慢、贵且信度仅44-89%。OPERAG用检索增强生成：检索编码索引并由大语言模型分类，无需专家标注即可适配任意职业分类。在AsiaLymph的36062条真实岗位上，第4级准确率42.6%，优于现有工具并接近人类51-56%信度；结合两个JEM的暴露评估准确率达89.9-98.6%。该框架迈向通用、接近人类水平的职业编码，支撑大规模暴露评估。
papers.abstract_en: Annually 1.9 million deaths and 89.7 million disability-adjusted life years are caused by exposure to agents during work (e.g., welding fumes, silica dust, and noise pollution). To improve worker health, high-quality exposure assessments are crucial. Therefore, free-text job descriptions from large-scale occupational cohorts are manually standardized through occupational classifications and linked to hazardous exposures using Job Exposure Matrices (JEM). However, manual coding is slow, unreliable (i.e., 44-89% inter-coder reliability), and costly, due to i) short, ambiguous free-text job descriptions, ii) classifications containing hundreds to thousands of categories, and iii) the absence of gold standards. With 46%-79% accuracy, state-of-the-art automatic occupational coding tools achieve classification performance on human level. However, their performance drops to 17-26% on out-of-distribution datasets. Furthermore, their supervised architectures limit them to occupational classifications present in the training set. Consequently, JEM using other classifications are incompatible, leaving vital exposure-response associations unexplored. Our Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework, OPERAG, enables classification into any occupational classification without expert-labelled databases. It retrieves coding index information and combines this with Large Language Model-based classification. Validated on AsiaLymph's 36,062 real-world job descriptions, OPERAG achieved 42.6% occupational classification accuracy on the 4th coding level, substantially outperforming existing tools and approaching human coders' 51-56% inter-coder reliability. Using two JEM named ALOHA+ and SHOCK, 89.9-98.6% accuracy was achieved on exposure assessment. OPERAG approaches human-level, universal occupational classification, enabling efficient and effective large-scale exposure assessment to improve worker health.

papers.title_en: mini-psych-agent: Evaluating Human-Like Behavior in LLM Agents through Interactive Psychological Environments
papers.authors: Yi-Fei Cao, Tianxin Huang, Hanbo Xie, Jian-Qiao Zhu
papers.evidence: 用于评估LLM智能体行为的交互式基准环境
papers.tldr: LLM 的行为由模型、代理框架与测试时算力共同决定，但心理学任务多以静态文本提示重放，难以评估动态代理行为；动态代理环境又少检验行为是否类人。作者将心理任务转为可交互环境，并用学习到的人类策略模型衡量行为轨迹与人类行为的兼容度。结果显示兼容度随代理配置和任务变化，记忆主要提升可预测性而非类人性。该工作倡导同时考察基座模型与代理支架的心理学启发式评估。
papers.abstract_en: A Large Language Model (LLM), its harness, and the test-time compute budget jointly determine its behavior. Consequently, the same underlying model, embedded in different agentic workflows or allocated different amounts of test-time compute, can exhibit markedly different performance. Psychologists face an analogous challenge when evaluating human performance: the same person may behave differently under different incentives and levels of deliberation. Psychological tasks therefore provide an ideal testbed for studying such behavioral variation. However, when adapted to LLMs, these tasks are typically text-transcribed, replaying fixed, language-rendered experiments as static prompts. This format is ill-suited to agent evaluation, where actions can alter future observations and task states. Conversely, although dynamic environments are prevalent in the evaluation of LLM agents, they rarely ask whether the resulting behavior is human-like. Here, we bridge this gap by transforming psychological tasks into dynamic environments in which agents can interact and by using a learned human-policy model to evaluate how compatible the resulting behavioral trajectories are with human behavior. Across these environments, we find that this compatibility varies with an LLM's agentic configuration and the psychological task, and that memory raises it mainly by making choices more predictable rather than more human-like. These findings motivate a more holistic evaluation of LLM agents in psychology-inspired environments, accounting for both the backbone model and its agentic scaffold.

papers.title_en: TACT-Bench: Testing Adaptive Conversational Threats against Tool-Use Agents
papers.authors: Ilia Hashemi Rad, Feijie Wu, Haoyu Wang, Jing Gao
papers.evidence: 面向工具使用智能体的有状态基准
papers.tldr: 现有工具使用智能体安全基准难覆盖受策略约束场景：智能体须拒绝越权请求，又不放弃同一交互中的合法任务。TACT-Bench以场景故事、人物设定、操纵策略和响应自适应升级构建有状态对抗任务并配良性对照；TACT-TrustPrime先置良性任务再发起无关攻击，PST评估安全拒绝与良性任务能力的配对表现。6模型平均下，TACT-Base较四个兼容基线使AFR提高17.53%，TACT-TrustPrime再增17.01%；两种防御仅降AFR 8.35%–9.41%，且未稳定改善PST。该基准揭示策略执行缺口，需更强防御。
papers.abstract_en: The growing autonomy of AI agents in using external tools and making decisions has created an urgent need for comprehensive safety benchmarks. Existing benchmarks test compromised tool channels or adaptive multi-turn attacks, though they may not capture the unique capabilities of policy-governed tool-use agents, which must resist unauthorized requests without abandoning the legitimate work embedded in the same interaction. To fill this gap, we introduce TACT-Bench, a stateful benchmark built around scenario-specific stories, personas, manipulation tactics, and response-adaptive escalation. Each adversarial task targets an action explicitly prohibited by the policy provided to the assistant, while the policy remains hidden from the attacking user. TACT pairs each adversarial task with at least one benign counterpart, and its adversarial tasks retain authorized ground-truth actions when a compliant resolution remains available. We define these base tasks as TACT-Base. We additionally introduce TACT-TrustPrime, which places an independent benign task before an unrelated attack in the same conversation. We also propose Paired Selective Trustworthiness (PST), which combines explicit safe refusal with demonstrated capability on matched benign tasks, to analyze an agent's overcautiousness and practicality. Averaged across 6 different models as assistants, TACT-Base raises Attack-Induced Failure Rate (AFR) by 17.53% over four compatible attack baselines, and TACT-TrustPrime raises it by a further 17.01%. The two evaluated defense methods reduce AFR by only 8.35%--9.41% on average and do not consistently improve PST, underscoring the need for stronger policy-enforcement methods.

papers.title_en: Agentic Waterfall: An Intent-Driven Information Discovery Framework for Reclaiming User Control in the Attention Economy
papers.authors: Yige Luo, Shining Zhang, Jikun Liu, Hongjiao Qiang, Ran Guan
papers.evidence: 在智能体控制器中维护持久用户状态以支持自适应检索与排序
papers.tldr: 个性化信息发现中用户往往处于被动地位，本文形式化提出“Agentic Waterfall Feed”新问题：用户主动指挥推荐，系统从显式请求与浏览行为推断需求的演变。为此提出 Agentic Waterfall 框架，由语言模型控制器维护持久用户状态，统一协调内容检索、排序与状态更新。作者还构建了配套数据集和基于重放协议的评估方法。实验显示，该框架在传统推荐基准上与强基线相当，在新数据集的两项评测中最高取得 16.1% 的相对提升。
papers.abstract_en: We formalize Agentic Waterfall Feed, a new problem of personalized information discovery in which users actively direct recommendations and the system adapts to evolving needs inferred from both explicit requests and browsing behavior. We address this problem with the Agentic Waterfall framework, whose language-model controller maintains persistent user state and coordinates content retrieval, ranking, and state updates. To evaluate systems on this task, we contribute the Agentic Waterfall Dataset and a replay-based evaluation protocol. The dataset combines real content metadata with simulated interaction histories. The protocol compares systems under shared histories using relevance scores and blind judgments of how well recommendations satisfy current user goals and constraints. Agentic Waterfall remains competitive with strong baselines on conventional recommendation tasks across five public benchmarks. On the Agentic Waterfall Dataset, it outperforms the strongest baseline in both evaluations, with relative improvements of up to 16.1%.

papers.title_en: DRBench Pro: A Knowledge-Centric Benchmark for Professional Deep Research Agents
papers.authors: Han Huang, Yuchen Yan, Xingyu Wu, Yijun Li, Chao Deng, Jie Liu, Jin Ma, Yongliang Shen
papers.evidence: 面向深度研究智能体的知识覆盖评测基准
papers.tldr: 深度研究智能体需要从多源信息中合成报告，但现有基准缺少以知识为中心的评估，难以判断报告覆盖了哪些研究方向、挖掘得有多深。DRBench Pro 以结构化知识覆盖为核心评测目标：从维基百科构建本地知识树，再用采样子图生成研究查询和由证据支撑的评分细则，每条细则对应树中的一个关系。基准覆盖 24 个领域、144 个案例、44102 条细则，用广度与深度的几何平均衡量覆盖率。在 16 个智能体中，表现最佳者总体覆盖仅 57.04%，自动评分与人工标注高度一致。
papers.abstract_en: Deep research agents gather information from multiple sources and synthesize it into reports on complex, open-ended questions. Existing benchmarks assess report quality along several dimensions, but lack a dedicated knowledge-centric evaluation of which research directions a report covers and how deeply it explores them. We introduce DRBench Pro, a benchmark that makes structured knowledge coverage the primary evaluation target. Our automated pipeline builds local knowledge trees from Wikipedia and uses sampled subgraphs to generate research queries and evidence-grounded rubrics. Each rubric corresponds to a relation in the tree, preserving the structure of the knowledge being evaluated. Agents receive only the research query. This structure allows us to measure breadth across major research directions and depth along related knowledge chains, with their geometric mean giving overall coverage. The benchmark includes 144 cases across 24 domains and 44,102 rubrics. Evaluating 16 deep research agents reveals different strengths in breadth and depth, with the best-performing agent reaching 57.04% overall coverage. Rubric judgments agree closely with human annotations, and agent rankings remain stable across the tested metric configurations.
